Summary: Structural synthesis with transparent evidence attribution, expandable on Analysis and MAP (decision record steps 6 and 7)
Description: 1) Original intent: Decision Record 2026-10-11 section 1 (transparent evidence attribution: every material statement labelled documented, supported by relationships, inferred or unresolved, never an inference worded as established, nothing suppressed because it is consequential) and steps 6 and 7 (structural synthesis; Analysis and MAP expand every material claim to its evidence). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the brief shows a SYNTHESIS of statements each carrying exactly one status; (b) DOCUMENTED statements quote the filing (accession, passage, matching outcome, amounts with the filing's wording, no magnitude derived); (c) SUPPORTED statements are licensed by admitted relationships and list them (formation, a classification of dated filings, counts over admitted relationships); (d) INFERRED statements name what they rest on, list the relationships behind them and say what the filings document; (e) UNRESOLVED statements name what could not be matched, what is INDETERMINATE and what is not assessed; (f) an unnamed affiliate stays an unnamed affiliate in every statement; (g) every statement that asserts something expands to evidence on Analysis, and the MAP relationship list expands to the same instrument, matching outcome, passage and accession; (h) two entities live (registry and runtime-admitted); existing suites green; the benchmark baseline untouched. 3) Current implementation state: built. analyticalsynthesis.js (pure), admissionreport.js (the capital-event admission report is frozen into the snapshot), the SYNTHESIS row in the brief with expandable evidence, MAP detail lines. Tests: qa_synthesis 16/16 on real filings and matches; live on two entities (qa_synthesis_live). 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1401, KRYL-1402, KRYL-1403, KRYL-1398. Formation is not a verdict (section 21): the statuses describe evidentiary support and gate nothing. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes. Status: opened and built 2026-10-11.
